text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after Kawakami Princess's debut,
I've been
entering her in scrimmages in
addition to regular
races to get her more
familiar with competing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you really mean it?! Then I'm
ready for
another race!
choice_data_list: Your running is even better than before!
Your running is even better than before!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... W-wait. I need a breather...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer
<username>.
Seeing
as our runners are both in their junior
year
still, I think we should be careful
not to overdo
it...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I learned a lot from you. Let's
do this
again!
choice_data_list: Indeed. Thank you so much for today.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... But I'm still packed full of
energy... I was
just on the brink of
getting a real feel for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, there isn't anyone left for
her to
race today. So instead...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Visualization training?
choice_data_list: Shall we try some mental training?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... This is a race with eighteen runners. At the moment, sixteen are ahead of me...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gah... Huff... Huff... Grrr...
choice_data_list: Focus! They're closing in from behind!
Stay focused! They're closing in from behind!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ugh! But I'm the only one here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Imagine all I want, it's still only me!
Competition
is a fierce back-and-forth
marked by sweat and

determination—this doesn't have any of
that!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gah?! Are you talking about the
imaginary race in
episode twenty-two
where Princess Fighter faces
fifty
versions of herself?
choice_data_list: Didn't they have training like that in PreFie, too?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Nghhh...
choice_data_list: If you can do that too, you'll become even stronger.
If you can do that too, you'll become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Mumble... In this race, the Umamusume with the hair bow is... Mumble...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since I gave her that advice, Kawakami
Princess
has been poring over race
footage of other
Umamusume to serve as
references for her
visualization training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew... That's the sixth one down.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But still, nothing beats watching a race
live. The
drive to tear each other apart.
The spectators
going wild in the stands...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: Then how about we go watch an actual race sometime?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cuuup?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've brought Kawakami Princess
with me
to Kyoto to watch the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer, is this really the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoooooa! The race where they decide
who's the
ultimate princess—the queen!
I'm going to enter
this race too, one day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I must confess she seems a little more
excited
than I imagined...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure that seeing a live race in
action will
be a good experience for her.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Which Umamusume will shine bright as
the
queen?! A total of eighteen
participants will
compete on today's
track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Next to appear on the turf is Sweep
Tosho! She
recently overwhelmed her
opponents en route to
victory at the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Blond Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Sweep! Please make sure you get
to the
gate early today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
...My goodness. The caliber of the
younger
Umamusume entering this race
has certainly
changed.

text_block_list.name: Lady with Hat
text_block_list.text: I concur. Sigh... If she's entering too, then I hope this doesn't turn into a repeat of the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Bleeeeh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race turns out to be an intense
nail-biter.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The leader splendidly breaks away from
the rest
of the pack. Have we already
decided our new
queen?! But wait,
coming from the outside is...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho! She's gaining ground
rapidly from
the outside!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're even! Sweep Tosho mounted a
ferocious
pursuit from the outside and
has now pulled
ahead! She's first! Sweep
Tosho comes in first
place!

text_block_list.name: Blond Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaah! Go Sweep! You killed that!
You're the
beeeest!

text_block_list.name: Blue-haired Spectator
text_block_list.text:
That finishing burst was crazy cool. Hey,
make
sure you win the next one too,
Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Lady with Hat
text_block_list.text:
She performed well today, including
making it to
the starting gate on time.
However...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... You see that? That's the power
of magic.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho, you put on a magnificent

performance today! Would you share a
few words
on how you're feeling right
now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Not interested! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sweep Tosho?! Wait, come back!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
She's still behaving more like a bratty
princess. I can
only hope that next year
she will display a little more of
the
decorum befitting a queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So that was the Queen Elizabeth II Cup...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wooooow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do it, too! I'm going to win
this race
one day and become queen!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I need your help! Let's do some
training
right away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Back to the academy, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We hurry back to the academy and
manage to
slip in while there's still time
to use the track.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess enters the gate. The
Queen
Elizabeth II Cup is about to
begin...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ka-chak!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And they're off! Phoooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, she's decided to base her
visualization
training on the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup. But she
seems different
from before...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oookaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's finally able to practice on her own
through
visualizing a race.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, one day... One day, I swear...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely win the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup and
become my ideal princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaah! I'm gonna make this
happeeeen!
